questions.subject: Indian Economy
questions.question: Which of the following methods is used to measure National Income by calculating the total value added at each stage of production?
questions.explanation: The Value Added Method (also called the Production or Output Method) measures National Income by summing the value added at each stage of production, thereby avoiding double counting.

questions.subject: Indian Economy
questions.question: The Planning Commission of India was substituted by NITI Aayog in which year?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) was established on 1 January 2015, succeeding the Planning Commission which had been in existence since 1950.

questions.subject: Indian Economy
questions.question: Which rate does the Reserve Bank of India charge when commercial banks borrow money from it for a short period by selling government securities?
questions.explanation: The Repo Rate is the rate at which the RBI lends money to commercial banks against government securities; banks sell securities to RBI with an agreement to repurchase them later.
